text: Program Description 1. Course Introduction Editor Notes: This program fosters engineering and technical talents suiting the world aviation industry development needs. Students gain the following knowledge and ability: Comprehensive professional education of aircraft design and maintenance; Master the technologies and theory of related fields, including mechanics, materials science, electronics, measurement and control, market economy and other basic knowledge; Professional knowledge of broad aircraft design and maintenance and have comprehensive ability and engineering innovation capabilities. 2. Algebra 1, Algebra & Trigonometry 1, Programming in C Language 1, Orientation Program 1, Basic Chinese Speaking 1, Comprehensive Chinese(1) 1, An Introduction to China 1, Physical Education 1-7 Semester 2: An Introduction to Aeronautics, Calculus for Engineering Sciences (1), Physics (1), Physics Experiments (1), Basic Chinese Listening, Comprehensive Chinese (2), Chinese Culture 2, Calculus for Engineering Sciences (2), Essential English Writing Semester 3: Physics Experiments (2) 3, Physics (2), Comprehensive Chinese (3), Academic English Writing, Engineering Training, Engineering Economics, Reading in Chinese, Communication in Chinese, Information Retrieval & Utilization Semester 4: Numerical Analysis, Mathematics Foundation for Information System, Electronic Circuit, Engineering Electromagnetic Field, Digital Circuit, Course Project: Electrical & Electronic Technique, Electronic Circuit Experiment, Principles of Communication, FPGA and its Applications, Probability & Statistics, Matlab Applications, Intermediate Chinese Semester 5: Control System Engineering, Electric Machinery, Analogue Electronics, Microwave Technique and Antenna, Signals and Accreditation Editor Notes: Accredited by the Ministry of Education, China. NUAA's degree is accepted worldwide. NUAA's International Link: NUAA's degree allows you to take your project in China, your home country or a third country. Brief Introduction to Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics Editor Notes: NUAA is now a comprehensive university especially featured with Aerospace Engineering. Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics(NUAA), established in 1952, enjoys a well-balanced development of multiple disciplines in natural sciences, humanities, social sciences, management, etc. with the characteristics of aeronautics, astronautics and civil aviation. NUAA is among the first batch of national key universities entitled to award doctoral degree, master's degree and bachelor's degree. It is one of the 52 universities with graduate school in China, and it has also been listed in the "National Project 211" as one of the 100 key universities for the 21st century. Presently, NUAA has established international cooperation and exchange with more than 60 universities and institutions all over the world. Learn More about Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics 6. About IEC Editor Notes: IEC has carried out a wide range of multi-level and diversified international cooperation education. The earliest institution in Jiangsu Province to set up Sino-foreign cooperatively-run schools. The aim is to cultivate an international higher vocational college with international vision and complementary advanced cultures between the East and the West. Carried out exchange student programs with high-level universities in the United States, Britain, France, Australia, Sweden and Ukraine. Joint training programs have been carried out with universities in Britain and Australia, and recruited students from nearly 20 countries. Rapid development of school-running scale and the continuous improvement of school-running quality is distinctive international education characteristics.
